description: You are using Aerobridge, an open-source drone/UAV fleet management system. Your task is to create a new flight plan in the system. Log in to the admin panel at http://localhost:8000/admin/ using username 'admin' and password 'adminpass123'. Navigate to 'GCS Operations' > 'Flight Plans' and click '+ Add'. Fill in the required fields: (1) Name: 'Mumbai Coastal Survey', (2) Plan file json: enter a non-empty JSON object such as {"name": "Mumbai Coastal Survey"} (this field cannot be blank or empty), (3) Geo json: enter a valid GeoJSON object such as {"type": "Point", "coordinates": [72.8777, 19.0760]} (this field cannot be blank or empty). The 'Is editable' checkbox can remain checked. Click Save. Do not log out after saving.
